svg.text: The mode, the track, and the four
The 16 steps of the selected track.
Hold one and turn a knob = lock
Which 16 the STEP keys mean: step
FUNC + pad: mute on the next bar
A-D: the four values on screen,
OK picks or confirms, CLR goes back
FUNC + key: the word under it
Printed TRK 1-7; in STRATA the same
Lit dim, bright while held or on
